answer_1.quote: We apply our edit operation based model to five NLP tasks: text normalization, sentence fusion, sentence splitting & rephrasing, text simplification, and grammatical error correction (GEC).
datasets: English and Russian data (Sproat and Jaitly, 2016)
answer_1.outputs: sequences generated from edit operations applied to source sentences

answer_2.quote: We report sentence error rates (SERs↓) for text normalization, SARI↑ scores (Xu et al., 2016) for sentence fusion, splitting, and simplification, and ERRANT span-based P(recision)↑, R(ecall)↑, and F0.5 -scores on the BEA development set for grammar correction.
